mechanisms.label: Static and type checks
mechanisms.establishes: Declared lint and type properties over inspected code

mechanisms.label: Property, stateful, metamorphic, and exhaustive tests
mechanisms.establishes: Named implementation properties over generated and bounded cases
mechanisms.does_not_establish: Proof over every input or source universe

mechanisms.label: SMT model proofs
mechanisms.establishes: Named temporal, occupancy, and precedence properties for encoded models
mechanisms.does_not_establish: A refinement proof from model to production Python

mechanisms.label: Temporal-overlay model
mechanisms.runs: not TLC-run in the current harness
mechanisms.establishes: An inspectable finite abstraction and invariant vocabulary
mechanisms.does_not_establish: Current implementation conformance; the model is structurally stale and one invariant drifted

mechanisms.label: Executable temporal invariant mirrors
mechanisms.establishes: Selected temporal invariants against the real selector implementation
mechanisms.does_not_establish: Complete legal-time doctrine or every model invariant

mechanisms.label: Independent structural and trace checker
mechanisms.establishes: Bounded roots, links, and declared transition folding for fixtures
mechanisms.does_not_establish: Source-language entailment, legal authority, or a stable public certificate product

mechanisms.label: External institutional adjudication
mechanisms.establishes: Disposition of the exact reviewed case

explicit_nonclaims: No end-to-end formal verification of the LawVM compiler.
No formal refinement map from the TLA+ model to Python.
No general formal semantics of legislative amendment language.
No independent external audit of the complete evidence system.
No universal frontend mutation-boundary or receipt enforcement.
No proof that the declared source universe is globally complete.
